scope: Classical mapping-class ingredients for the exact pointwise free-meridian stabilizer. The based-meridian-to-arc argument, cutting deduction, explicit reversed-index band formula, and deletion left inverse are supplied in the proof. No historical-priority, formal-verification or external-review claim.

sources.title: A Primer on Mapping Class Groups

uses.statement: Proper arcs with boundary/marked endpoints; the arc version of homotopy versus isotopy and ambient isotopy.
Individually isotopic disjoint proper-arc collections can be simultaneously ambient-isotoped relative to the boundary. Distinct protected stem endpoints satisfy the hypotheses.

uses.statement: The braid group is the mapping class group of the boundary-fixed marked disk; adjacent half twists are its standard generators.
